# Test fixtures

`reference_2020q1_s17.{npz,pt}` is a golden batch for the retained reference
model (J_POINT_BOTH), outer quarter 2020q1, seed 17. It holds 276 rows
(game × offense five × defense five) from 5 whole games, so point pooling by
game and offense five is intact.

- **`.npz`** holds three groups of arrays:
  - model inputs (`input_*`), labels (`label_*`), keys and the environment
    (`env_*`);
  - outputs of the pre-refactor `Model16` on this batch, for the final weights
    (`old_*`) and the five-checkpoint mixture (`old_avg_*`);
  - the production predictions saved by the v16 campaign for the same rows
    (`saved_primary_*`, `saved_checkpoint_average_*`).
- **`.pt`** holds the saved state dicts: the final fit and the checkpoints for
  epochs `checkpoint_epochs`.

Generated by `scripts/make_parity_fixture.py` from
`experiments/cache/joint_capability_2026_09_19_v16_fast2_ready`, using the
pre-refactor code (tag `pre-refactor-2026-10-09`).

`history_2020q1_final.npz` holds 200 training rows (history-mode states, 2020q1
final prefix). The rows carry their keys and the exact inputs produced by the
pre-refactor `TrainingData.batch`. It was written by `scripts/export_store.py`.

The three fixture files are not in the public repository: they hold rows derived from Basketball
Reference play-by-play (README.md, `scripts/publish_repo.sh`), so the tests that read them need a
private copy.
